full_page.content:
Page 43 Cont.
Apr. 17 Anna Haener - 57 - badly burned Febr. Ist ... still poorly .....
18 Michael Johnson - 9 - Spinal manigitis since Jan. 4th - had pneu- monia about Dec. 20th ... Only prayers now Apr. 24 blest him with relic at 9:30 P.M. April 25 hopes revive - P.M. improving.
Mrs. Mary Glass - of Buffalo - teleph. - Arthritis - and sister Mrs. Averey.
Nixk Gorno - 60 - dying of stomach cancer - large Family ask prayers
Page 44 Apr. 20 Elva Mulheran - 51 - methodest - double goitre - fears operation, yet find difficulty in breathing etc.
21 Mrs. Clara Schumacher - 46 - bone-cancer - has husband and four lit- tle girls depending .... Enrolled To-day - 6 month since she took to bed.
22 Alfred Rinklin - 19 - lutheran - operation five weeks ago tuomer on brain. Doctors hopeless ... Enrolled here at 9:20 p.m.
Anna Sheehan
17-24 Mrs. Mary A. Dougherty - 64 - Cancer of rectum operation proposed Apr. 19th. Enrolled day before - coming from Port Huron ..... operation put off till end of week. Thursday 2ist daughters returned to Wash'n D.C. reporting decided improvement ... Today patient and husband comes all looking improved ... Deo B.
David Moirarity - 42 - Diabetes quite in agony - wife convert
Delvina Kent - 88 - Thank God for good health - makes own dresses - sews without glasses ...
Page 45 Apr. 26 Mrs. Agnes McDonald - 40 - Terrible Head-aches. . Operation some time in Jan. 28 days in bed .....
Loretta Fix of Monroe - 35 - T.B. hopes to get out of operation. Mrs. Allen - over 70 - strok sometime ago - can walk again but weak ...
